title: On off-diagonal operators in matrix-weighted spaces
summary: In this paper we prove matrix-weighted inequalities for fractional operators and their commutators. We do so by developing the theory of convex body domination for such operators. Using this approach we prove quantitative estimates for the fractional integral operator (or Riesz potential) and its commutators, and prove matrix-weighted Gagliardo-Nirenberg-Sobolev inequalities for vector-valued functions.
